name: Gongxianosaurus
sum: Gongxianosaurus is a basal sauropod from the Early Jurassic Ziliujing Formation of Sichuan, China, one of the most completely known early sauropods.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; the holotype was left in situ under a protective exhibition hall.
material: Four fragmentary to complete specimens from the Ziliujing Formation.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: He et al. 1998

sources.text: He, Xinlu 1998. A new species of sauropod from the Early Jurassic of Gongxian Co., Sichuan. Acta Geologica Sichuan 18: 1–7.

dates_note: The Wikipedia lead gives Sinemurian-Pliensbachian, while PBDB places the occurrence in the Toarcian; the age is not settled in the sources read.
